errors.text: The predicted transient rise followed by a drop in HCP atom count conflicts with the target trend of increasing HCP atom fraction with temperature.

The proposed experiment lacks thermal-only, indentation-only, and temperature-matched unloaded controls, so reduced dislocation line length cannot distinguish thermal disorder from mechanically induced annealing.
Localized amorphization, dislocation climb, cross-slip, and shear localization are asserted as a specific causal sequence without direct support from the cited evidence or target results.
